The background features shelves with books and small decorative items. (2) A female character with blonde hair tied in a bun, wearing black-rimmed glasses and a blue knitted vest over a white top, looks towards the waiter with an annoyed facial expression. A female voice speaks with high pitch variability and a comedic, slightly annoyed tone. A 'pop' variety SFX marks a cut. (2) Dialogue ensues between the male waiter, who uses a level, calm, and professional vocal contour, and the blonde female customer, who exhibits a rising intonation and high-energy delivery. The background music maintains its steady rhythm. Percussive impact sounds coincide with comedic visual changes. (4) The final segment features a climax in dialogue intensity. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This comedic skit satirizes the social awkwardness arising from resting facial expressions. It explores the misunderstanding between a focused waiter and an overly concerned/judgmental customer who interprets his neutral face as being in a 'bad mood'.
